hooks.command: FILE=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | jq -r '.file_path // .filePath // empty') && [ -n "$FILE" ] && case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.md) npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null;; esac; exit 0

BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ] || [ "$BRANCH" = "master" ]; then echo "Direct edits on $BRANCH are blocked. Create a feature branch." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
if git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null && git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; echo 'Uncommitted changes detected. Review with git diff.' >&2; exit 0
